title: Contents Schedule for Home Oxygen Therapy: Included Contents and Post-Cap Contents Fees
content:
# Contents Schedule — Home Oxygen Therapy

Gas and liquid contents of Home Oxygen Therapy are treated in two ways, depending on where the rental stands. The figures for each system class are these.

| System class | Contents included in the monthly payment during the payment period | Monthly contents code after the cap | Monthly contents fee after the cap (USD per month) | Contents deliveries required within a month for that month's contents fee (count) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Stationary Concentrator Oxygen (E1390) | yes | none | 0.00 | 0 |
| Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) | yes | E0443 | 79.12 | 1 |
| Concentrator with Home Fill System (E1390 + K0738) | yes | none | 0.00 | 0 |
| Concentrator with Portable Oxygen Concentrator (E1390 + E1392) | yes | none | 0.00 | 0 |
| Liquid Oxygen System (E0439 + E0434) | yes | E0442 | 79.12 | 1 |
| High-Flow Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) | yes | E0443 | 79.12 | 1 |

## Footnotes

(a) "Contents included" states whether gas or liquid contents are included in the monthly payment during the payment period. It reads yes for every class.

(b) The monthly contents code after the cap is the billing code of the monthly contents fee billed after the payment cap, or none. The monthly contents fee after the cap is the fee-schedule monthly contents payment after the cap; it is 0.00 when no contents are billable, which is the case wherever the code reads none.

(c) The delivery count is the number of contents deliveries required within a month for that month's contents fee to be billable; it is 0 when the class has no contents billing.

## Points read from the schedule

- Three classes carry a contents code after the cap: Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) and High-Flow Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) with E0443, and Liquid Oxygen System (E0439 + E0434) with E0442. Each of them lists 79.12 per month and requires 1 contents delivery within the month.
- Stationary Concentrator Oxygen (E1390), Concentrator with Home Fill System (E1390 + K0738) and Concentrator with Portable Oxygen Concentrator (E1390 + E1392) list none, 0.00 and 0.
